notice: Every action here maps to a handler compiled into the app. Editing this file can retune existing actions; it cannot add new ones.

families.label: System Report
families.description: Read-only. Nothing here changes your machine.

families.label: Power & CPU
families.description: Stop Windows downclocking or parking the core your game is running on.

families.label: Network
families.description: Latency and throughput. Fixes here affect the whole system, not just the emulator.

families.label: GPU & Scheduling
families.description: Which GPU renders, how its driver behaves, and how the scheduler treats its threads.

families.label: Windows Shell
families.description: Scheduler, kernel, services and shell. System-wide; nothing here is GameLoop-specific.

families.label: GameLoop
families.description: Engine registry keys, launcher behaviour and GameLoop's own Config.ini.

families.label: Emulator Guest (ADB)
families.description: Settings inside the running Android guest. Most revert on restart or a factory reset.

families.label: Cleanup & Junk
families.description: Files Windows and the emulator regenerate anyway. Nothing here is reversible.

actions.label: Generate system report
actions.description: CPU, GPU, RAM, hypervisor state, elevation and every detected emulator. Read-only.

actions.label: Check for a pending reboot
actions.description: A pending reboot silently stops several tweaks from taking effect. Read-only.

actions.label: Explain why actions are locked
actions.description: Lists every unavailable action and the specific requirement it failed. Read-only.

actions.label: Ultimate Performance power plan
actions.description: Creates and activates the Ultimate Performance scheme, falling back to High Performance if the template is unavailable. Undo restores your previous plan.

actions.label: Keep CPU at full clock
actions.description: Sets the minimum processor state to 100% so cores do not downclock between frames. On a laptop this raises idle power draw and heat.

actions.label: Disable core parking
actions.description: Stops Windows parking idle cores. Parking forces the game thread to migrate, which shows up as a hitch.

actions.label: Aggressive turbo boost policy
actions.description: Sets the processor boost mode to Aggressive while plugged in. Leaves the battery policy alone.

actions.label: Wireless adapter: maximum performance
actions.description: On battery, Windows defaults this to Medium Power Saving, which throttles the radio and is a real source of periodic latency spikes. Sets both AC and DC to maximum performance.

actions.label: Disable USB selective suspend
actions.description: Stops Windows dropping a USB device to save power, which can cause a mouse or controller to stutter or disconnect.

actions.label: TCP autotuning: normal
actions.description: Restores the Windows default receive-window autotuning. Many 'optimizers' disable it, which is slower on high-latency links, not faster.

actions.label: Flush DNS cache
actions.description: Clears the resolver cache. Harmless, and worth doing after a router or ISP change.

actions.label: Use Cloudflare DNS (1.1.1.1)
actions.description: Sets a static resolver on every active physical adapter. Undo returns the adapter to DHCP-assigned DNS.

actions.label: Reduce delayed-ACK latency
actions.description: Acknowledges every packet immediately and disables Nagle's algorithm per interface. Helps small, frequent packets; slightly increases overhead on bulk transfers.

actions.label: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
actions.description: Sets the Windows IPv6 component preference to favour IPv4. Only useful when IPv6 routing on your network is broken. Does not fully disable IPv6, which Microsoft advises against.

actions.label: Enable Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling
actions.description: Lets the GPU schedule its own work instead of Windows doing it. Helps on most modern GPUs. A Windows setting that affects every vendor.

actions.label: Raise the GPU timeout (TDR) delay
actions.description: A long emulator frame can trip the 2-second watchdog and reset the driver mid-match. Raising this to 8s prevents that. The trade-off: a genuinely hung GPU takes 8s to recover.

actions.label: Reset the GPU timeout to default
actions.description: Removes any custom TDR delay and returns to the Windows default of 2 seconds.

actions.label: Force the emulator onto the dedicated GPU
actions.description: Writes the same key the Windows Graphics settings page uses, for every emulator process found. The executable path comes from detection, never from this file.

actions.label: Report NVIDIA driver state
actions.description: Driver version, memory and power limit via nvidia-smi. Read-only.

actions.label: Enable Game Mode
actions.description: Lets Windows prioritise the foreground game over background work.

actions.label: Disable Game Bar background recording
actions.description: Background capture costs frames continuously, even when the overlay is never shown.

actions.label: Prefer exclusive fullscreen
actions.description: Removes a composition pass between the emulator and the display. Can occasionally cause alt-tab to be slower.

actions.label: Raise the Games scheduling class
actions.description: Raises MMCSS GPU priority, thread priority and I/O priority for the Games task, and lifts the network throughput cap that applies while multimedia is active.

actions.label: Visual effects: best performance
actions.description: Disables window animations and shadows. Purely cosmetic change, small overhead reduction.

actions.label: Disable pointer acceleration
actions.description: Gives 1:1 mouse movement. This changes aim feel rather than latency, but most players want it. Requires signing out to take effect.

actions.label: Disable EcoQoS power throttling
actions.description: Stops Windows demoting background threads. Helps an emulator whose helper threads get parked mid-frame, at the cost of battery life.

actions.label: Report GameLoop install
actions.description: Install root, launcher, ADB path and total install size. Read-only.

actions.label: Clear GameLoop cache
actions.description: Deletes cache, temp, log and shader-cache folders inside the detected install. A stale shader cache after an update is a common cause of stutter. Not reversible - it is a cache.

actions.label: Stop GameLoop launching at logon
actions.description: Removes the Run entry so the emulator does not hold GPU and disk resources in the background.

actions.label: Exclude the GameLoop folder from Defender
actions.description: Emulator disk I/O is heavy and constant, and real-time scanning of it is a measurable cost. The trade-off is real: files in that folder would go unscanned. Only do this for an install you trust.

actions.label: List connected emulator devices
actions.description: Shows which emulators ADB can currently reach. The emulator must be running. Read-only.

actions.label: Disable guest animations
actions.description: Sets all three Android animation scales to zero inside the emulator. The guest UI stops waiting on transitions. Reverted by a factory reset of the emulator.

actions.label: Hide touch point indicators
actions.description: Turns off the on-screen touch indicators, which draw on every tap.

actions.label: Use Google DNS (8.8.8.8)
actions.description: Sets a static resolver on every active physical adapter. Undo returns the adapter to DHCP-assigned DNS.

actions.label: Use Quad9 DNS (9.9.9.9)
actions.description: Quad9 blocks known-malicious domains at the resolver. Undo returns the adapter to DHCP-assigned DNS.

actions.label: Use OpenDNS (208.67.222.222)
actions.description: Sets a static resolver on every active physical adapter. Undo returns the adapter to DHCP-assigned DNS.

actions.label: Use AdGuard DNS (94.140.14.14)
actions.description: AdGuard DNS blocks ad and tracker domains at the resolver. Undo returns the adapter to DHCP-assigned DNS.

actions.label: Enable ECN (Explicit Congestion Notification)
actions.description: Lets routers signal congestion before dropping packets. Can help on congested wired networks; on others it makes no difference.

actions.label: Enable Receive-Side Scaling (RSS)
actions.description: Spreads network interrupts across CPU cores instead of funnelling them onto one. Helps under heavy network load.

actions.label: Export DNS snapshot (read-only)
actions.description: Writes the current DNS settings of every active adapter to a JSON file in the data folder. Changes nothing else.

actions.label: Turn off hibernate
actions.description: Deletes hiberfil.sys and frees gigabytes of disk. Re-enable any time from the same action, or by running powercfg /hibernate on.

actions.label: Let windows take focus immediately
actions.description: Removes the wait a window must observe before it may steal focus. Keeps the emulator responsive when it relaunches.

actions.label: Stop Store apps running in the background
actions.description: Force-denies background execution for Store apps. Removing the policy restores the default behaviour.

actions.label: Open menus instantly
actions.description: Sets the menu open delay to 0 ms. Makes right-click menus everywhere feel instant.

actions.label: Clean user temp folder
actions.description: Deletes junk in %TEMP%. Anything in use right now is skipped. Nothing here can be restored.

actions.label: Clean Windows temp folder
actions.description: Deletes junk in C:\Windows\Temp. Anything in use right now is skipped. Nothing here can be restored.

actions.label: Delete crash dumps and WER reports
actions.description: Removes Windows Error Reporting archives and Minidump files. You lose nothing you will need.

actions.label: Clear prefetch files
actions.description: Deletes *.pf prefetch history. Windows rebuilds it; the first launch of each app is a bit slower afterwards.

actions.label: Clear GPU shader caches
actions.description: Deletes NVIDIA and AMD shader caches. They rebuild on first use; expect a brief stutter until they do.

actions.label: VM RAM: 8 GB
actions.description: Set the Tencent engine's fixed VM memory to 8192 MB. Only useful when GameLoop's Auto value launches too low; restart GameLoop to apply.

actions.label: VM CPU: match host cores
actions.description: Set VMCpuCount to the number of physical cores this machine reports. More vCPUs is not automatically faster; benchmark it.

actions.label: VM CPU: 6 cores
actions.description: Set VMCpuCount to 6. A safe fixed preset for 6-core desktops; restart GameLoop to apply.

actions.label: FXAA: off
actions.description: Set the Tencent engine's FXAA quality. Anti-aliasing is not exposed in GameLoop's normal panel; lower settings reduce GPU cost.

actions.label: FXAA: balanced
actions.description: Set the Tencent engine's FXAA quality. Anti-aliasing is not exposed in GameLoop's normal panel; lower settings reduce GPU cost.

actions.label: FXAA: high
actions.description: Set the Tencent engine's FXAA quality. Anti-aliasing is not exposed in GameLoop's normal panel; lower settings reduce GPU cost.

actions.label: Renderer: enable Vulkan
actions.description: Set EnableVulkan=1 in the Tencent engine key. Some GPUs render faster; others regress. Benchmark before keeping it.

actions.label: Renderer: disable Vulkan
actions.description: Set EnableVulkan=0 so GameLoop stays on its OpenGL/DirectX path.

actions.label: OpenGL version: 3.x
actions.description: Set OpenGLVersion=3 in the Tencent engine key. Restart GameLoop to apply.

actions.label: Renderer engine: GLES
actions.description: Set RendererEngine=GLES in the Tencent engine key for the OpenGL path.

actions.label: VSync: off
actions.description: Disable the emulator's V-Sync. Lower input latency; enable it again only if tearing is the real problem.

actions.label: VSync: on
actions.description: Enable the emulator's V-Sync to stop tearing.

actions.label: Shader cache: on
actions.description: Set ShaderCacheEnabled=1 in the Tencent engine key.

actions.label: Shader cache: off
actions.description: Set ShaderCacheEnabled=0 in the Tencent engine key.

actions.label: Local shader cache: on
actions.description: Set LocalShaderCacheEnabled=1 in the Tencent engine key.

actions.label: Local shader cache: off
actions.description: Set LocalShaderCacheEnabled=0 in the Tencent engine key.

actions.label: Rendering optimization: on
actions.description: Set RenderOptimizeEnabled=1 in the Tencent engine key.

actions.label: Rendering optimization: off
actions.description: Set RenderOptimizeEnabled=0 in the Tencent engine key.

actions.label: Prioritize dedicated GPU
actions.description: Set GraphicsCardEnabled=1 and SetGraphicsCard=1 so GameLoop binds to the discrete GPU on dual-GPU laptops.

actions.label: Let GameLoop choose the GPU
actions.description: Set GraphicsCardEnabled=0 so GameLoop follows Windows' GPU preference.

actions.label: Disable GameLoop internal messaging
actions.description: Set InterMessageLocalSwitch=0 in the Tencent engine key to stop the launcher's internal message channel.

actions.label: Disable game pre-download
actions.description: Set PreDownloadCloudSwitch=0 so GameLoop does not pre-download updates in the background.

actions.label: Disable GameLoop autostart
actions.description: Set AutoStart=0 in the Tencent engine key so the launcher stops starting with Windows.

actions.label: Disable AppMarket autostart
actions.description: Set AutoStart=0 in the AppMarket key so the store front stops launching in the background.

actions.label: Disable all GameLoop background activity
actions.description: Bundle: stop autostart, pre-download, internal messaging and AppMarket autostart in one pass.

actions.label: Hardware video decoding: on
actions.description: Set EnableHardwareDecoding=1 in Config.ini under [engine]. The file is backed up before editing and only this line is restored on undo.

actions.label: Hardware video decoding: off
actions.description: Set EnableHardwareDecoding=0 in Config.ini under [engine].

actions.label: Config.ini renderer: DirectX
actions.description: Set Engine_100038.Renderer=0 (DirectX/Smart) in Config.ini. Registry stays the runtime source; the INI keeps it sticky.

actions.label: Config.ini renderer: OpenGL+
actions.description: Set Engine_100038.Renderer=1 (OpenGL+) in Config.ini.

actions.label: Config.ini renderer: Vulkan
actions.description: Set Engine_100038.Renderer=2 (Vulkan) in Config.ini.

actions.label: VM DPI: 320
actions.description: Set VMDPI=320, the legacy control profile for a 1440x1080 guest. Restart the emulator to apply.

actions.label: VM resolution: 1440x1080
actions.description: Set VMResWidth=1440 and VMResHeight=1080 in the Tencent engine key.

actions.label: Force DirectX rendering
actions.description: Set ForceDirectX=1 in the Tencent engine key. Use only when the OpenGL path is broken on this driver.

actions.label: Give the engine high CPU priority
actions.description: Set CpuPriorityClass=3 (High) for aow_exe.exe through IFEO. Applied at every process start.

actions.label: Give the engine top disk priority
actions.description: Set IoPriority=3 (Critical) for aow_exe.exe through IFEO so guest disk I/O is not queued behind background work.

actions.label: Launcher: above-normal CPU
actions.description: Set CpuPriorityClass=6 (Above Normal) for AppMarket.exe.

actions.label: Launcher: high CPU
actions.description: Set CpuPriorityClass=3 (High) for AppMarket.exe. Benchmark it; a busy store UI can steal time from the game.

actions.label: Lower the store/ads UI priority
actions.description: Set cef_frame_render.exe to Below Normal CPU and Low I/O priority so the launcher's web UI yields to the engine.

actions.label: Stop Windows scaling GameLoop
actions.description: Add HIGHDPIAWARE to GameLoop's emulator executables in AppCompatFlags. Stops DPI virtualization blur and scaling cost.

actions.label: DSCP EF marking for GameLoop
actions.description: Tag GameLoop traffic with DSCP 46 (Expedited Forwarding) so routers with QoS treat it as latency-sensitive.

actions.label: Remove QoS bandwidth reservation
actions.description: Set NonBestEffortLimit=0 so Windows stops reserving 20% of the link for QoS-aware apps. Reboot to apply.

actions.label: Persistent DSCP policy for GameLoop
actions.description: Create per-app GPO QoS policies with DSCP 46 and unlimited throttle for GameLoop executables.

actions.label: Exclude GameLoop from Defender scans
actions.description: Add the GameLoop install folder to Defender path exclusions. Emulator disk I/O is heavy; the trade-off is that this folder is no longer scanned in real time.

actions.label: Guest: disable animations
actions.description: Set window, transition and animator scales to 0 inside the emulator. Makes the UI feel faster; a factory reset reverts it.

actions.label: Guest: force GPU composition
actions.description: Tell SurfaceFlinger to GPU-composite every layer (service call SurfaceFlinger 1008 i32 0). Some scenes lose FPS; opt in only if it helps.

actions.label: Guest: background process limit 0
actions.description: Set background_process_limit=0 so Android keeps no cached background processes. The foreground game is untouched.

actions.label: Guest: reap cached helpers sooner
actions.description: Raise only the low-memory-killer tail bands so cached helpers (gameloopplus, AppMarket, qqdownloader) are reaped earlier. Foreground and visible bands stay stock. Session-only.

actions.label: Guest: stop camera service
actions.description: Ask the guest to stop its camera service. A VM has no camera; some GameLoop images restart it immediately and the result says so.

actions.label: Guest: pre-launch cleanup
actions.description: One-shot: kill cached background processes and trim caches before launching the game. Does not touch foreground or persistent apps.

actions.label: Guest: stop Google Play services
actions.description: Disable com.google.android.gms for the session. Frees RAM but breaks anything that depends on Play services; a factory reset or re-enable restores it.

actions.label: Guest: AOT-compile all packages
actions.description: Run cmd package compile -m speed -f --full -a to precompile packages and reduce JIT stutter. Takes a few minutes.

actions.label: Guest: HWUI renderer OpenGL
actions.description: Set debug.hwui.renderer=opengl and restart the Android runtime. Some GameLoop images ignore it; reboot to revert.

actions.label: Guest: kernel tuning bundle
actions.description: Bundle vm.swappiness=10 with the noop I/O scheduler on every block device. Requires root; reports honestly when the guest refuses. The scheduler change lasts until the guest reboots and is not journaled.

actions.label: Guest: add performance props
actions.description: Append a documented performance block to /system/build.prop. Requires root and a writable system partition; the original file is copied to /sdcard/build.prop.backup first. Undo is manual: restore that backup.

actions.label: Guest: lower swappiness
actions.description: Set vm.swappiness=10 so the guest prefers reclaiming cache over swapping game pages. Requires root.

actions.label: Guest: noop I/O scheduler
actions.description: Set the noop/none scheduler on every block device. Best on SSDs; do not use on spinning media. Lasts until the guest reboots.

actions.label: Guest: trim caches
actions.description: Ask Android to trim cached files. One-shot and harmless.

actions.label: Guest: stop Play Store
actions.description: Force-stop com.android.vending for this session. It restarts on demand.

actions.label: Guest: disable Facebook app
actions.description: Disable com.facebook.katana and com.facebook.orca inside the emulator. Facebook's background services are a well-known RAM/CPU drain in GameLoop.

actions.label: Short quanta + high foreground boost
actions.description: Set Win32PrioritySeparation=0x26. Short variable quanta with a strong foreground boost gives the game more CPU time and lowers input latency.

actions.label: System-wide 0.5 ms timer
actions.description: Set GlobalTimerResolutionRequests=1 so any process requesting a 0.5 ms timer applies it system-wide. Reboot to apply.

actions.label: Keep the kernel in RAM
actions.description: Set DisablePagingExecutive=1. Keeps the kernel and drivers in physical memory and removes kernel page-fault stalls. Costs roughly 200-400 MB of RAM.

actions.label: Remove the network throttling cap
actions.description: Set NetworkThrottlingIndex=0xFFFFFFFF. Removes the default 10-packets/ms cap. On some systems this raises NDIS DPC latency instead; benchmark it.

actions.label: Reserve less CPU for background apps
actions.description: Set MMCSS SystemResponsiveness=10, the lowest value the kernel honours. The game gets the other 90%.

actions.label: Disable Nagle's algorithm
actions.description: Set TcpAckFrequency=1, TcpNoDelay=1 and TcpDelAckTicks=0 on every TCP/IP interface. Small packets are sent immediately.

actions.label: Stop idle-mouse throttling
actions.description: Set DisableUserPresenceQos=1 so Windows does not treat an idle mouse as 'away' and quietly throttle the game.

actions.label: Stop Windows replacing the GPU driver
actions.description: Set SearchOrderConfig=0 so Windows Update does not silently replace a working GPU driver mid-session.

actions.label: Disable MPO (stutter fix)
actions.description: Set DWM OverlayTestMode=5 to disable Multi-Plane Overlay. Fixes some flicker and stutter on NVIDIA and AMD; reboot to apply.

actions.label: Cap paged-pool growth
actions.description: Set PoolUsageMaximum=60 to avoid the slow-after-hours paged-pool growth pattern. Reboot to apply.

actions.label: Faster shutdown: don't clear pagefile
actions.description: Set ClearPageFileAtShutdown=0. Windows stops wiping the pagefile on every shutdown, which shortens shutdown and avoids needless disk writes.

actions.label: Disable page combining
actions.description: Set DisablePageCombining=1. Can free memory-management overhead on some builds, but it removes a memory-saving feature. Reboot to apply.

actions.label: Group services into fewer processes
actions.description: Set SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB to 20 GB so Windows groups service hosts into fewer processes. Trims per-process overhead but reduces service isolation. Reboot.

actions.label: Printer stack: high port thread
actions.description: Set PortThreadPriority=1 under LanmanServer. A legacy print-spooler tweak; keep it only if you understand the trade-off.

actions.label: Disable VBS / HVCI
actions.description: Turn off Virtualization-Based Security and Hypervisor-Enforced Code Integrity. This can recover 5-10% FPS in the emulator but lowers malware resistance. Reboot.

actions.label: Disable CPU mitigations
actions.description: Set FeatureSettingsOverride and FeatureSettingsOverrideMask to 3. Removes Spectre/Meltdown mitigations for speed at a real security cost. Reboot.

actions.label: BCEdit timer tweaks
actions.description: Disable dynamic ticks, force the platform tick and request the enhanced TSC sync policy. Can help or hurt depending on firmware. Reboot.

actions.label: Remove the HPET override
actions.description: Delete the useplatformclock BCD value so Windows uses the invariant TSC instead of forcing HPET. Reboot.

actions.label: Disable NTFS 8.3 names
actions.description: Disable short-filename creation on NTFS. Speeds up directory churn in emulator disk images.

actions.label: Verify and enable TRIM
actions.description: Set DisableDeleteNotify=0 so SSDs receive TRIM. One-shot; the previous state is not known, so there is nothing to revert.

actions.label: Disable Modern Standby
actions.description: Set PlatformAoAcOverride=0 to force classic S3 sleep on laptops that expose it. Reboot; some machines do not support S3 at all.

actions.label: Lower audio latency
actions.description: Raise the Audio MMCSS task to GPU Priority 8, Priority 6, Scheduling Category High and SFIO Priority High.

actions.label: Disable Sticky Keys popup
actions.description: Set StickyKeys Flags=506 so five taps of Shift no longer opens the accessibility prompt mid-game.

actions.label: Disable Filter Keys popup
actions.description: Set Keyboard Response Flags=122 so a held key no longer opens Filter Keys mid-game.

actions.label: Disable Windows 11 Widgets
actions.description: Hide the Widgets button and disable the news/interests feed.

actions.label: Disable push notifications
actions.description: Set ToastEnabled=0 so notifications stop interrupting fullscreen play.

actions.label: No automatic update restart
actions.description: Set NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers=1 so Windows Update cannot reboot the machine while you are playing.

actions.label: Reduce mouse input buffer
actions.description: Set MouseDataQueueSize=20 under mouclass. A shallower queue lowers mouse latency on some controllers.

actions.label: Reduce keyboard input buffer
actions.description: Set KeyboardDataQueueSize=20 under kbdclass.

actions.label: Disable NTFS last-access writes
actions.description: Set NtfsDisableLastAccessUpdate=1. Stops a metadata write on every file read, which matters for emulator disk images.

actions.label: Disable Prefetch
actions.description: Set EnablePrefetcher=0. Reduces background disk work on fast SSDs, but slows cold application launches.

actions.label: Disable memory compression
actions.description: Disable the Memory Compression store. Frees the compression worker's CPU at the cost of more pagefile use.

actions.label: Disable Windows Search indexer
actions.description: Stop and disable the WSearch service. Removes constant background disk and CPU work.

actions.label: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
actions.description: Stop and disable SysMain. On an SSD its prefetching is mostly unnecessary background I/O.

actions.label: Disable telemetry services
actions.description: Disable DiagTrack and dmwappushservice and set AllowTelemetry=0.

actions.label: Disable Windows Error Reporting
actions.description: Stop and disable WerSvc and suppress the crash UI. Cuts background crash uploads.

actions.label: Disable Delivery Optimization
actions.description: Disable the DoSvc peer-to-peer update cache and set DODownloadMode=0.

actions.label: Disable Office telemetry
actions.description: Set the Office 16.0 client telemetry policy to disabled. Office keeps working; it stops phoning home.

actions.label: Disable Cortana / Bing search
actions.description: Set BingSearchEnabled=0, CortanaConsent=0 and AllowCortana=0. Stops web-backed search and its background work.

actions.label: Disable background UWP apps
actions.description: Set GlobalUserDisabled=1 so Store apps stop running in the background.

actions.label: Disable ETW autologgers
actions.description: Set Start=0 for the DiagLog and SQM autologgers. Reduces tracing overhead; diagnostics tools lose data.

actions.label: Faster shutdown and responsiveness
actions.description: Set WaitToKillServiceTimeout=2000 and ClearPageFileAtShutdown=0.

actions.label: Disable Storage Sense
actions.description: Turn off Storage Sense's automatic cleanup schedule.

actions.label: Disable Start ads and suggestions
actions.description: Stop Start-menu suggestions, silent app installs and preinstalled app pushes.

actions.label: Stop Edge running in the background
actions.description: Set Edge BackgroundModeEnabled=0 so the browser does not keep background processes alive.

actions.label: Disable CEIP scheduled tasks
actions.description: Disable the Customer Experience Improvement Program and Application Experience upload tasks.

actions.label: Disable extra background services
actions.description: Disable a curated set of non-essential services: RetailDemo, MapsBroker, WMPNetworkSvc, PhoneSvc, Fax, RemoteRegistry and Geolocation.

actions.label: Trim working sets now
actions.description: Ask every user process to release its unused working set. One-shot; Windows refills the pages on demand.

actions.label: Optimize windowed games
actions.description: Set DirectXUserGlobalSettings SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1 so windowed/borderless games use the modern swap path.

actions.label: Enable Windows Game Mode flags
actions.description: Set AllowAutoGameMode=1 and AutoGameModeEnabled=1 under GameBar.

actions.label: Fullscreen optimizations for GameLoop
actions.description: Add the fullscreen-optimization compatibility flags to GameLoop's executables, preserving any existing layer flags.

actions.label: MSMQ: disable Nagle
actions.description: Set TCPNoDelay=1 under MSMQ Parameters.

actions.label: Raise IoPageLockLimit
actions.description: Set IoPageLockLimit=131072 (128 MB) so more I/O can be locked in memory. Helps heavy disk streams; can starve low-RAM systems.

actions.label: System cooling policy: active
actions.description: Set the processor cooling policy to Active so the fan ramps before the CPU downclocks.

actions.label: Disable Fault Tolerant Heap
actions.description: Set FTH Enabled=0. FTH silently shims crashing apps and adds overhead; disabling it makes real crashes visible.

actions.label: Intel Speed Shift EPP = 0
actions.description: Set the energy-performance preference to 0 on AC and battery. Lets the CPU pick maximum frequency sooner; costs power and heat.

actions.label: Disable processor idle states
actions.description: Set IDLEDISABLE=1 for AC and battery so the CPU does not enter deep C-states. Raises idle power and heat.

actions.label: Boost policy: maximum
actions.description: Set PERFBOOSTPOL=100 so the processor boosts aggressively when a game thread needs it.

actions.label: Disable PCIe ASPM
actions.description: Set the PCI Express link state power management to Off. Removes a common source of micro-stutter; adds a little idle power.

actions.label: Never sleep the disk
actions.description: Set the disk idle timeout to 0 so the emulator's disk image is never spun down mid-session.

actions.label: NVIDIA: Direct Flip + GPU timer
actions.description: Set EnableDirectFlip=1, EnableIndependentFlip=1, UseGpuTimer=1 and per-core DPC scheduling on nvlddmkm.

actions.label: NVIDIA: disable HDCP
actions.description: Disable HDCP 2.2 initialization on the NVIDIA GPU class key. Removes display-path overhead when no protected content is played.

actions.label: NVIDIA: disable driver preemption
actions.description: Disable mid-buffer and async preemption on nvlddmkm. Can reduce micro-stutter; a hung GPU command can stall longer.

actions.label: NVIDIA: disable telemetry
actions.description: Opt out of NVIDIA telemetry, stop and disable NvTelemetryContainer, and disable its scheduled tasks.

actions.label: NVIDIA: allow GPU counter access
actions.description: Set RmProfilingAdminOnly=0 so GPU performance counters can be read without elevation.

actions.label: NVIDIA: enable GSP firmware
actions.description: Enable the GPU System Processor firmware on the NVIDIA class key. Usually lowers latency on RTX 20-series and newer.

actions.label: NVIDIA: MSI interrupt mode
actions.description: Set MSISupported=1 and MessageNumberLimit=2 on the NVIDIA PCI device. Lowers DPC latency on many boards. Reboot.

actions.label: NVIDIA: extend RM watchdog
actions.description: Raise the NVIDIA RM watchdog timeout to 10 seconds so a long shader compile is not mistaken for a driver hang.

actions.label: AMD: disable ULPS
actions.description: Disable Ultra Low Power State on the AMD GPU class key. Stops clock ramp delays when a frame burst starts.

actions.label: AMD: disable Crash Defender
actions.description: Stop and disable the AMD Crash Defender service. It can mask real driver resets and adds a background process.

actions.label: AMD: flip queue size 1
actions.description: Set FlipQueueSize=1 on the AMD GPU class key to reduce render-ahead and input lag. May lower average FPS.

actions.label: AMD: surface format optimization
actions.description: Enable AMD surface-format replacements and Catalyst AI texture optimization on the GPU class key.

actions.label: AMD: disable StutterMode
actions.description: Set StutterMode=0 on the AMD GPU class key. Only relevant on Polaris through RDNA2; newer cards ignore it.

actions.label: Disable adapter interrupt moderation
actions.description: Disable interrupt moderation on active physical adapters. Lowers latency but raises CPU interrupts; benchmark it.

actions.label: Disable NIC power saving
actions.description: Disable 'allow the computer to turn off this device' on active physical adapters.

actions.label: Hot DNS resolver cache
actions.description: Raise the DNS positive cache TTL to 24 hours so repeated lookups stay local.

actions.label: Clean GameLoop shader cache
actions.description: Delete GameLoop's ShaderCache and GPU cache folders. They regenerate; stale shaders are a common cause of post-update stutter.

actions.label: Clean AppMarket web cache
actions.description: Delete the AppMarket/CEF Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache and WebKit folders.

actions.label: Clean GameLoop logs
actions.description: Delete loose GameLoop log files so the next benchmark run is easy to read.

actions.label: Clean MobileGamePCShared logs
actions.description: Delete logcat, dump and log artifacts under MobileGamePCShared.

actions.label: Clean NVIDIA shader caches
actions.description: Delete NVIDIA DXCache and GLCache. They rebuild on demand.

actions.label: Clean AMD shader caches
actions.description: Delete AMD DxCache and VkCache. They rebuild on demand.

actions.label: Clean DirectX shader cache
actions.description: Delete the per-user D3DSCache folder.

actions.label: Purge Windows Update cache
actions.description: Stop wuauserv and delete the SoftwareDistribution download cache. Windows re-downloads what it still needs.

actions.label: Purge Delivery Optimization cache
actions.description: Delete the Delivery Optimization download cache.

actions.label: Clear crash dumps and WER
actions.description: Delete per-user crash dumps, minidumps and queued Windows Error Reporting files.

actions.label: Remove Windows.old
actions.description: Delete C:\Windows.old. This removes the rollback copy of the previous Windows install; it cannot be undone.

actions.label: Deep component-store cleanup
actions.description: Run DISM /StartComponentCleanup /ResetBase. Frees component-store space but makes installed updates non-removable.

actions.label: Clean C:\aow_drv.log
actions.description: Delete the legacy GameLoop AOW driver log. It can grow without bound.
